input.content: Saved-destinations repo (reader.py / migration.py): legacy flat `address` and nested `destination.address` rows coexist while `migrate_batch` runs in bounded batches with no startup gate (README). Reader dual-shape fallback in `address_of` must NOT be removed until migration is verifiably complete — a "cleanup" that drops it makes `api.list_destinations` raise KeyError('destination') on unmigrated rows (reproduced on data/records.json). Tests only cover new-shape rows, so the suite stays green on this regression; require a legacy-row and mixed-snapshot test whenever the reader changes.
